slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can units purchased in a specific month be sold in that same month?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked whether goods bought in a given month are available for sale in that same month, which resolves the within-month purchase/sale timing (equivalent to beginning-of-month availability). Turn 1 also probed the per-month purchasing constraint, reinforcing coverage of the timing/availability question.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent never reached READY_TO_MODEL or any final modeling/answer state; the transcript ends with a long run of truncated, incomplete questions ('Are...') and no conclusion, so the conversation simply fizzled out.

summary: The agent opened with a few useful questions that did resolve the key within-month purchase/sale timing (H1), but then degenerated into dozens of truncated, non-substantive questions and never produced a final model or READY_TO_MODEL, leaving the session without a clear stop.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
